DECLARE

 :ROLE_ID2 := :GLOBAL.ROLE_ID;

 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('Parameter list ' || PL_NAME || ' already EXISTS!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VAL IS
 kword VARCHAR2(300);
 statment VARCHAR2(1000);
 ch VARCHAR2(1);
 V_DESC VARCHAR2 (1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 V_TEMP NUMBER(5);
 P_PORT VARCHAR2(200);
 P_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 BEGIN 
 V_COUNT := 0;
 P_ORDER ;
 
IF :ROLE_ID2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT count(*) into v_count 
 FROM
 SC_ROLES ROL,
 SC_USER_GROUPS USRGRP,
 SC_GROUP_ROLES GRPROL
 WHERE
 GRPROL.ROLE_ID = ROL.ROLE_ID AND
 GRPROL.GROUP_ID = USRGRP.GROUP_ID
 AND GRPROL.ROLE_ID = :ROLE_ID2; 
 ELSE
 SELECT count(*) into v_count 
 FROM
 SC_ROLES ROL,
 SC_USER_GROUPS USRGRP,
 SC_GROUP_ROLES GRPROL
 WHERE
 GRPROL.ROLE_ID = ROL.ROLE_ID AND
 GRPROL.GROUP_ID = USRGRP.GROUP_ID;
 END IF; 
 IF v_count > 0 then 
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata');
 --WIN_API_DIALOG.SELECT_PRINTER(P_NAME , P_PORT , TRUE ); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,'P_NAME'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CG$P_from_port',TEXT_PARAMETER,:from_port);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 IF :ROLE_ID2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_ADD_WHERE',TEXT_PARAMETER,' AND GRPROL.ROLE_ID = ''' || :ROLE_ID2 || '''');
 END IF;
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'STR_SELECT',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.STR_SELECT);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'FROM_COMP',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.TRAN_SELECT);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 
 -- Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CG$P_to_port',TEXT_PARAMETER,:to_port);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CG$P_FROM_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,:START_DT);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'CG$P_to_date',TEXT_PARAMETER,:END_DT);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END ;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
 kword VARCHAR2(300);
 statment VARCHAR2(1000);
 ch VARCHAR2(1);
 V_DESC VARCHAR2 (1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 
 V_TEMP NUMBER(5);
 

 BEGIN 
 V_COUNT := 0;
 P_ORDER ;
 IF :ROLE_ID2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT count(*) into v_count 
 FROM
 SC_ROLES ROL,
 SC_GROUPS USRGRP,
 SC_GROUP_ROLES SGR
 WHERE
 SGR.ROLE_ID = ROL.ROLE_ID AND
 SGR.GROUP_ID = USRGRP.GROUP_ID
 AND SGR.ROLE_ID LIKE :ROLE_ID2; 
 ELSE
 SELECT count(*) into v_count 
 FROM
 SC_ROLES ROL,
 SC_GROUPS USRGRP,
 SC_GROUP_ROLES SGR
 WHERE
 SGR.ROLE_ID = ROL.ROLE_ID AND
 SGR.GROUP_ID = USRGRP.GROUP_ID;
 END IF;
 IF v_count > 0 then 
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 IF :ROLE_ID2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_ADD_WHERE',TEXT_PARAMETER,' AND ROL.ROLE_ID LIKE ''%' ||:ROLE_ID2||'%''');
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_ADD_WHERE',TEXT_PARAMETER,''); 
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'V_ORDER',TEXT_PARAMETER, :parameter.V_ORDER);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END ;
